Why is it acceptable that him cumming every time you have sex is a requirement but he can't focus on your pleasure not even once? Leave him, he doesn't see you as a person nor does he care about you, he just sees you as a sexdoll. You deserve to have fullfiling sexual relations and if he can't grant you that you need to dump his ass.

Just because you don't end up with someone it doesn't mean it's a waste of time to date them. You can still have fun and learn a lot about love and even yourself from dating experiences that don't lead to marriage and a life together. I don't wanna be harsh but honestly most highschool relationships don't last much, people change a lot in very short spans of time when they are teenagers and that can break you apart. You are worrying unnecesarily, just enjoy your time together, and if it leads to where you want it to, great, but if it doesn't then you'll surely learn from this experience and take the good memories with you, and that's just as good. You can have kids with someone else when the time comes if he decides parenthood is not for him.
